limitations: AnalyzedWaveSubject and OrderedChildBinding are caller-constructed untrusted inputs, not certificates, attestations, validators, or proof.
subject_id, binding_id, and observation_provenance_ref are opaque caller-controlled audit text; they are not credentials and their truth or global uniqueness is not verified.
Exact live Python object identity, not an ID string or value equality, is the identity available to a future reviewed validator.
A binding records one exact parent reference and tuple order but does not prove that the children actually belong to that parent.
The contract does not prove temporal continuity, containment, distinct market spans, anchors, pivots, degree, timeframe, completion, pattern, family, validity, or fatality.
Zero and one child are allowed and make no completeness or cardinality statement.
The same live parent or child may appear in separate untrusted bindings; there is no global ownership or parent-replay registry.
Within one binding, parent-as-child, repeated exact child identity, and duplicate parent/child subject IDs are rejected as Runtime identity-safety policy, not protected Elliott rules.
Copy and deepcopy return the same immutable object; dataclass replacement constructs a distinct untrusted identity.
Pickle is rejected, while JSON-compatible audit data and explicitly reconstructed objects carry no authority and are not accepted by either certifier.
Frozen dataclasses prevent ordinary mutation but do not claim protection against hostile same-process reflection or object.__setattr__.
There is no Wave 1–5 enum, exactly-five rule, normal-impulse subdivision tuple, family assignment, or methodology behavior in this baseline.

A future family producer must verify the exact binding, parent, ordered children, nested-proof subjects, provenance, cardinality, slot semantics, and required families; strings alone must never be trusted.
The existing structural-invalidity certificate contract is not subject-bound; this baseline does not retroactively bind existing structural violations to analyzed subjects.
No validated-family producer exists, the family registry remains empty, and no family certificate can currently be issued.
The contract has logical same-process identity utility only and provides no cross-process identity, cryptographic authenticity, ACL protection, or physical immutability.
SUBJECT-ORDERED-CHILD-BINDING-V1 is a writable development logical baseline and is not physically sealed.
